authorisation: User brief 2026-11-01: bounded architectural feasibility experiment on the frozen WL59 P intrinsic K's shared 16-input-to-8-mixture incoming angular compression under qualified, independently tagged collided first-exit references. Isolated probe generation and representation-space analysis only; no model, checkpoint, rank, loss, threshold, K/C ownership, F/S or coupled-GI change; no successor.

implemented_algebra.source: experiments/fnto_rule57/r57_model.py Transport.apply/coefficients with experiments/fnto_persist59/runtime.py state (frozen WL59 P)
implemented_algebra.equation: scatter[j,o,c] = sum_r O[r,o,c] * ( sum_{e:dst_e=j} W[e,r,c] q[src_e,r,c] + sum_k U[j,k,r,c] sum_i V[i,k,r,c] q[i,r,c] ),  q[i,r,c] = sum_a A[r,a,c] (1-beta[i,a]) x[i,a,c];  total = scatter + B x
implemented_algebra.A: softmax(in_logits, dim=0): (8 mixtures x 16 incoming bins) per RGB channel, column-stochastic, one global matrix per channel shared by every port and geometry
implemented_algebra.O: softmax(out_logits, dim=1): (8 mixtures x 64 outgoing bins) per channel, global
implemented_algebra.beta: geometry-only zero-collision quadrature of the archived geometry file (q=256, seed 57501); model collided budget d[i,a] = 1-beta[i,a]
implemented_algebra.port_factorisation: for fixed geometry, source port i and channel c the scattered response to unit incident flux in bin a is row a of D_i A_c^T G_i with D_i = diag(d[i,:]) and G_i[r,(j,o)] = T_r[j,i,c] O[r,o,c], T_r[j,i,c] = sum_{e:src=i,dst=j} W[e,r,c] + sum_k U[j,k,r,c] V[i,k,r,c]
implemented_algebra.normalised_coordinates: Z_i = D_i^{-1} R_i (16 x Q). Model: Zhat_i = A_c^T G_i exactly. Because every column of A_c sums to one, A_c^T 1_8 = 1_16, so 1_16 lies in range(A_c^T) for every parameter value of the architecture.
implemented_algebra.consequence: With P1 = 11^T/16 and C_i = (I-P1) Z_i, every member of the architecture family (any parameters, any training) has incoming column space span(1) + T with T a subspace of 1-perp of dimension <= 7 shared by all ports/geometries of a channel. Absolute and contrast errors in Z coordinates both equal ||(I-P_T) C_i||^2 after the free span(1) component.
implemented_algebra.raw_metric_conversion: raw error = D_i (Z error); per probe row a the raw squared error equals d[i,a]^2 times the Z squared error, so raw bounds lie within [min d^2, max d^2] of the Z bounds; min d over selected ports and geometries is recorded.

port_selection.information_used: archived geometry only (rest material coordinates rest_xyz, face index node[:,15]*5, parent, model beta). No probe response, model output, error or checkpoint is read.

slots.name: top_far_control
slots.note: 4.95 cm from dent centre, 2 cm from slab sides

port_selection.ordering: ports on the slot face sorted lexicographically by (round(rest-xy distance to target, 1e-9 m), port index)
port_selection.nondegeneracy: accept the first port in that order with min over the 16 bins of (1-beta) >= 0.5 at BOTH geometries and rest-xy distance >= 0.01 m from every slab side; otherwise continue in the same order
port_selection.correspondence: identical port index at rest and pt0 (fixed refined-mesh topology); record rest_xyz, current xyz, face, parent, area, mean triangle normal/tangent and beta rows for both geometries before any reference generation

probes.definition: x[i,a,c] = 1 for the selected port i and incoming bin a in all three channels, else 0: unit incident flux, uniform on the port area and uniform in projected solid angle inside bin a (r57/p53 cell_source semantics, bins defined in each triangle's current frame)
probes.count: 2 geometries x 4 ports x 16 bins = 128 probes
probes.estimator: unchanged WL57 importance first-exit action (fast walker) with WL63 observational zero-collision/collided tags (tag_reference.py, AST-stripping proof); proposal is the one-hot field itself
probes.preflight_smoke_seeds: 689000000 + k (non-evidence throughput/memory only; preserved under preflight/, never analysed)
probes.budget_rule: Resource preflight times one 32M tagged packet for each geometry (slot 0, bin 0, smoke seed). Predicted generation time = mean packet seconds x 128 x K. K = 8 replicas if prediction <= 4 h; else K = 4 if prediction for K=4 <= 4 h; else STOP_RESOURCE. The resulting numeric budget is written to budget.json and committed before generation.
probes.replica_independence: every (probe, replica) packet is a separate action call with its own seed; probes and replicas are statistically independent

output_spaces.fine16: 3840 ports x 16 outgoing bins (r57 aggregate coarse=False: flux sum over nested 8x8->4x4 bins)
output_spaces.coarse: 240 x 1 cm material cells x 16 outgoing bins (r57 aggregate coarse=True); PRIMARY verdict space = WL59 directional evaluation interface
output_spaces.validity: all bounds are for the Frobenius norm of the stated space; output aggregation is a fixed linear map applied after the incoming map, so incoming-rank constraints are preserved

estimators.matrices: R_k[g,p,c,space] = 16 x Q collided first moments of replica k; Z_k = rows divided by d[i,a]; C_k = (I-P1) Z_k; zero-collision components and totals analysed separately
estimators.signal: S_C = U-statistic mean over ordered replica pairs k!=l of <C_k, C_l> (unbiased for ||C*||^2); S_Z likewise
estimators.cross_gram: Ghat = U-statistic mean over k!=l of C_k C_l^T (unbiased for C* C*^T)
estimators.relaxed_lower: L = sum of eigenvalues of Ghat beyond the 7 largest. tail-sum is concave in the Gram, so E[L] <= true floor (low-biased).
estimators.relaxed_upper: split replicas into first and second halves; V = top-7 eigenvectors of the half-1 U-statistic Gram; U12 = tr((I-VV^T) Ghat_half2); symmetrise with U21; E[U | V] = true residual for a fixed suboptimal V >= true floor (high-biased).
estimators.pooled_shared_relaxed: PRIMARY: one 7-dim T per channel shared by all 8 (geometry, port) matrices: Gram sum over matrices, same L/U construction
estimators.frozen_A: F_A = tr((I-P_TA) Ghat), TA = orthonormal basis of (I-P1) range(A_c^T) of the frozen checkpoint; fixed projector, unbiased
estimators.frozen_AO: frozen A and O with free signed spatial coefficients: for every destination cell the 16 x n_out block is projected onto span{a_r otilde_r^T} (absolute, Z) and span{(I-P1)a_r otilde_r^T} (contrast, C); otilde = O aggregated to the space; fixed projector, unbiased
estimators.frozen_O: every outgoing vector (per probe row, destination cell) of Z resp. C projected onto range(Otilde^T); secondary
estimators.outgoing_relaxed: generic rank-8 outgoing-mode bound of the n_out x (16*cells) matrix per port and pooled, same L/U construction; secondary
estimators.model: E_M = U-statistic of <Zhat-Z_k, Zhat-Z_l> (absolute) and of centered versions (contrast); raw collided, zero-collision (B column vs tagged physical) and total errors reported separately
estimators.uncertainty: delete-one-replica jackknife over the K independent replicas for every statistic and every pooled ratio; 95% interval = estimate +/- t(0.975, K-1) x SE_jk. L lower bound = L - t SE; U upper bound = U + t SE.
estimators.noise_reporting: per-entry packet variance (second - first^2/N) N/(N-1) summed to the replica-mean noise energy, compared with the across-replica sample variance; eigenvalues with jackknife SE, components with lambda > 3 SE are reported as physically resolved

nesting_invariants: In expectation: relaxed pooled <= frozen A <= frozen AO(contrast) <= model contrast error; frozen O(contrast) <= frozen AO(contrast); reported with intervals, not used to amend estimates

checkpoints.model_independence: model predictions are computed in a stage that reads no physical probe data; analysis reads both

gates.packet_physical: physical_passed (nonnegative, energy <= input + 5 SE, leaks+wrong_side <= 1e-5, no truncation), photons == N, expected_input == [1,1,1], proposal one-hot at the probe cell; any failure = STOP, failed packet preserved
gates.replay_definition: frozen GPU replay of WL59 P on archived pt0 against immutable WL59 actions_<seed>.pt pt0 F predictions for test fields 8, 9, 62, 63
gates.factorisation_definition: model scatter on the 16 probes of each (geometry, port) equals D_i A_c^T G_i built directly from the frozen coefficients; model Z prediction lies in range(A_c^T) and in the frozen AO block span to relative residual <= 1e-5
gates.geometry_identity: fresh r57 geometry features (xyz, rest_xyz, area, node, pair, prior, parent) bitwise equal to the archived files for rest and pt0
gates.precision: PRIMARY coarse space: every (geometry, port, channel) contrast signal S_C / SE_jk(S_C) >= 10 and pooled per-channel SE_jk(S_C)/S_C <= 0.05; else STOP_INSUFFICIENT_PRECISION (outcome D)

decision.metric: contrast metric in normalised coordinates: rho_X = sqrt(F_X / S_C) pooled over the 8 primary (geometry, port) matrices per channel in the coarse space. Rationale fixed before evidence: the architecture represents the span(1) component exactly for every parameter value, so the absolute-response floor equals the contrast floor numerator and is dominated in its denominator by a component the interface cannot lose. Absolute-metric values are reported, not adjudicated.
per_channel: A if sqrt(lower bound of L_pool / S_C) >= 0.10

else if sqrt(upper bound of U_pool / S_C) < 0.05: B if, for both primary seeds, sqrt(lower bound of F_A / S_C) >= 0.10; C if, for both primary seeds, upper bound of F_A <= 0.25 x lower bound of E_M (contrast energies) and sqrt(upper bound of F_A / S_C) < 0.10; otherwise nondecisive
decision.overall: Any precision/identity STOP -> D. Otherwise A if any channel is A; else B if any channel is B; else C if every channel is C; else D (nondecisive). Per-channel categories are always reported.
decision.descriptive_attribution: Frozen AO contrast floor versus model contrast error: if the upper bound of F_AO <= 0.25 x lower bound of E_M, at least 75% of the probe model contrast error energy is attainable within the frozen angular bases with free signed spatial coefficients and is attributed to unisolated spatial coefficient / geometry-conditioning / positivity-passivity / fitting constraints. Not a verdict criterion.
decision.scope: Verdict applies only to the tested probe population (2 geometries, 4 ports, 16 bins, homogeneous slab material) and the stated norms; no whole-architecture viability or falsification claim; no successor.

historical_context: WL59 Pair7 total directional error .42-.51 (1 cm/16-out, field62-field63, broad fields); WL63 tagged Pair7 collided error .41-.50 of the total-contrast norm; WL65 primary/U65 directional ratios. Different source populations and normalisations: context only, never pooled with probe metrics.
prohibited: rank or mixture-count change or sweep
